GAME ITEM ICON. Camera above the object looking down at about sixty degrees, the way the game RimWorld draws loose items on the floor. One object group, centred, filling about three quarters of the canvas.

Create an ORIGINAL game item sprite: a small open white cardboard tray holding three small upright glass vaccine vials in a row. Each vial is clear glass with pale liquid, a white label band with no writing, a silver aluminium crimp and a bright saturated GREEN rubber cap on top. Images 1 and 2 are our approved item icons: match their outline weight, shading, palette and finish only. Do NOT copy their shapes, and draw no syringe.

Draw ONLY this, alone on a plain pure white background.

Style: a sprite for the game RimWorld: a thick near-black outline around every shape, soft flat cel shading with two or three tones per material, pale panels, rounded corners, a few small clean details, no texture noise. The green caps are the only strong colour. Not a photograph, not a 3D render, not pixel art. It must read clearly when shrunk to 64 pixels: three big shapes, few small ones.

No people, hands, animals, text, letters, numbers, logos, floor, ground or cast shadow.
